name: Kurahashi Seira
source:
Seira who appears in the After Arc.
Seira’s very much become a high-school girl. She’s currently busy thinking about whether she should go study at a university after graduating. She's come back to [url=/c77885]Kanata[/url] and the two live together to some extent as she continues walking in the direction of her dreams.
